name: SINAPIS NIGRA
key_symptoms: Offensive breath, smelling like onions (Asaf; Armorac). Burning in stomach, extending up śsophagus, throat, and mouth, which is full of canker sores. Hot sour eructations. Colic; pains come on while bent forward; better, sitting up straight. Sweat better when nausea comes on.
Scalp hot and itches. Sweat on upper lip and forehead. Tongue feels blistered.
Cough is relieved by lying down.
Rheumatic pain in intercostal and lumbar muscles; sleeplessness from pain in back and hips.
